test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All eggs are millets.

All millets are balloons.

All balloons are prisoners.

Conclusions:

I. All balloons are eggs.

II. Some prisoners are millets.

III. All prisoners are balloons.
solution:
Statements:

All eggs are millets.

All millets are balloons.

All balloons are prisoners.

**__Venn diagram__:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/907dbd0a7c408d5514a648086f6824c942bcc6f13974e3e3dea0fbbb6a2cef07.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All balloons are eggs →** Does not follow** → From the given information we can say that all eggs are balloons but it will be wrong to say that all balloons are eggs and the same can be seen in the Venn diagram thus the conclusion does not follow.

II. Some prisoners are millets →** Follow **→ We have 'all millets are balloons' and 'all balloons are prisoners' so we can say that all millets are prisoners, therefore, the conclusion follows.

III. All prisoners are balloons → **Does not follow** → From the statement, 'all balloons are prisoners' we can only say that some prisoners are balloons but we have no information about all the prisoners thus the conclusion does not follow.

So **only conclusion II follows.**

Hence the correct answer is **option 3)**
